question: A scientist is trying to determine the proportion of white-eyed fruit flies in the environment. The white-eyed allele was found to be dominant to the red-eyed allele. The frequency of the red-eyed allele is 0.1. What is the proportion of flies who have white-eyes if the population is in Hardy Weinberg Equilibrium?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Frequency of red-eyed allele is 0.1" -> "Frequency of white-eyed allele is 0.9" -> "Proportion of homozygous dominant (white-eyed) = p^2" -> "Proportion of heterozygous (white-eyed) = 2pq" -> "p = 0.9, q = 0.1" -> "p^2 = 0.9^2 = 0.81" -> "2pq = 2 * 0.9 * 0.1 = 0.18" -> "Total proportion of white-eyed flies = p^2 + 2pq = 0.81 + 0.18 = 0.99" -> 99%

CHAIN: "Frequency of red-eyed allele is 0.1" -> "Frequency of white-eyed allele is 0.9" -> "p + q = 1" -> "p = 0.9, q = 0.1" -> "Proportion of homozygous dominant = p^2" -> "Proportion of heterozygous = 2pq" -> "p^2 = 0.81" -> "2pq = 0.18" -> "Total proportion of white-eyed = 0.81 + 0.18 = 0.99" -> 99%

CHAIN: "Red-eyed allele frequency is 0.1" -> "White-eyed allele frequency is 0.9" -> "Using Hardy-Weinberg: p + q = 1" -> "p = 0.9, q = 0.1" -> "Homozygous dominant proportion = p^2" -> "Heterozygous proportion = 2pq" -> "p^2 = 0.81" -> "2pq = 0.18" -> "Total white-eyed proportion = 0.99" -> 99%
analysis: The proportion of white-eyed fruit flies is calculated using Hardy-Weinberg principles, resulting in 99%.
